verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer portal offers a searchable, filterable reference for the full v2 REST API (docs-16). It also has a quickstart for making a first authenticated call to List companies (docs-21), plus documented auth, versioning and pagination conventions. There is no evidence of in-browser runnable examples or a try-it console, so only the reference half of the story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: explicit interactive try-it/runnable request execution in the reference, code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
